prompts.prompt: Use case: historical-scene. Original 1536x1024 3:2 landscape, convincing live-action historical photograph. In a modest 1842 Nauvoo Illinois household, TWO UNNAMED adult women prepare and mend simple clothing on a wooden table as an interpretation of the Relief Society's practical care, not a specific documented visit and not portraits of Emma Smith or any named person. Woman left about thirty in a faded muted blue small-print cotton day dress, woman right about fifty with a gently lined face in muted brown wool/cotton long dress; high modest necks, fitted natural-waist bodices, long sleeves, simple gathered skirts, plain work aprons, no hoop/crinoline silhouette, no zip fasteners. Hair center-parted and neatly pinned into low buns, no modern makeup. One woman holds up a simple plain child's shirt to inspect a hand-mended sleeve; the other has set needle and thread safely down and listens, with unmistakable reciprocal eye contact between them. A little basket of folded cloth, wooden spools, scissors, plain muslin shirt, daylight from a small multi-pane window, modest plaster/wood room, no sewing machine, plastic, modern electric fixtures or decorative posters. Gentle practical concern and companionship, not posed grinning. Lifelike hands, skin and woven cloth; clear photographic lens depth and natural window light, historically plausible ordinary materials. Clothes and setting are an interpretation informed by American ca1840 cotton dress museum records and 1842 donations of a gown, bonnet, quilt covers and silk. No text, no religious apparition, no painting/CGI/plastic skin.

Use case: photorealistic-natural. Original 1536x1024 3:2 landscape editorial photograph. A modern teenager about sixteen and an older adult neighbor about seventy repair a loose hinge on a low ordinary wooden garden gate together in daylight. Teen in muted rust long-sleeve shirt and jeans uses a HAND SCREWDRIVER aligned naturally with one screw on the hinge; older neighbor in faded green work shirt and trousers holds the gate steady, both looking down at the SAME hinge and communicating with calm focused attention. Teen's hands anatomically clear, screwdriver actually contacts a visible screw, gate and post join plausibly. A small open toolbox with a few hand tools safely on ground away from feet. Modest residential yard, soft daylight, ordinary plants and house background, no luxury setting. This illustrates putting scripture learning into simple service; no reading table, no food distribution, no gardening activity, no preaching pose. Relationship only neighbors, no inferred family relationship. Warm cooperation but no camera smile, no Jesus figure, no readable text/branding, no power tools. Crisp lifelike skin, hair, fabric, wood grain and lens depth, genuine candid photo realism, no illustration/CGI/airbrushing. Keep faces, hands, hinge visible for responsive study page.

Use case: photorealistic-natural. Original 1536x1024 3:2 landscape candid documentary photograph of ordinary modern community welcome. In a modest comfortable community meeting room, a small group of four adults of varied ages (one gray-haired woman, a middle-aged man, a younger adult woman, one older man) makes space in a loose circle of simple chairs for an adult woman in her forties arriving on her own with a tote bag. A seated younger woman moves a nearby empty chair slightly inward while looking directly into the arriving woman's eyes; the newcomer returns that mutual eye contact with a small relieved warm smile. Others show natural welcoming attention rather than all staring at camera. Diverse appearances, modest ordinary contemporary clothing in warm rust, deep blue, muted gold, green and neutral colors. Show social inclusion and shared participation; do NOT imply or label anyone's marital status, family relationship, widowhood, divorce, romance, matchmaking or sadness. No wedding imagery, no couples handholding, no Jesus figure. Natural soft daylight, realistic individual faces/hands, credible chair geometry and room. No readable signs or text, no logos, no staged stock-photo cheer, no painting, CGI or plastic skin. All key faces and chair invitation gesture inside frame.
